observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of an engine with a silver intake manifold, various hoses, and a yellow oil dipstick. The engine appears dirty and used, with visible wear and grime.
Photo 1 shows a wider view of the engine block with a black intake manifold, throttle body, and various sensors and hoses. The engine is resting on a concrete floor, possibly in a workshop or garage.

Photo 2 shows the top of the engine with a silver cover that has 'V6' and '15' written on it in green marker. The cover also has a circular logo with a star-like design. The engine block below is visible, showing the same components as in the other photos.
The engine appears to be a V6, as indicated by the 'V6' on the cover in photo 2.
The engine is not in a complete state; no compressor, alternator, or other accessories are visible in any photo.
The seller claims it is a complete engine with compressor and all operators for Toyota Venza, Camry, Sienna, Hylander, but no compressor or accessories are shown in the photos.
